base_geometry.use: base footprints and tagged road/path/barrier/gate candidates

supplemental_buildings.matching_osm_shapes: use current OSM, do not create duplicates
supplemental_buildings.license: ODbL-1.0 with upstream CC BY attribution

copernicus_dsm.use: coarse surface reference; not runtime terrain

official_palace_pages.use: names, qualitative layout, dated access notices

height_policy.numeric_tag: source attribute candidate, not independently measured reality
height_policy.multiple_values: hold for manual/parts review; no automatic first/max/min selection
height_policy.levels_only: estimated; pin explicit conversion factors in G03
height_policy.missing: estimated temporary default only; pin purpose-specific values in G03
height_policy.special_landmarks: separate review, no ordinary-building default applied silently
height_policy.roof_and_min_height: preserve separately; validate semantics in G03

ground_and_width_policy.no_source_ground: temporary local datum plane only where declared by G03

numeric_ground_datum.extent_policy: retained geometry envelope; not playable area

ground_and_width_policy.width_estimates: explicit estimated fields with model assumptions; never measured width
ground_and_width_policy.multi_level_features: classify/review before ground placement; no flattening all layers

route_policy.R1: Daehanmun to palace grounds/Junghwajeon front/accessible Seokjojeon exterior and return
route_policy.R2: verified crossing/footway connection to Seoul Plaza and City Hall; no invented direct crossing
route_policy.R3: verified public stonewall segment and return; full loop not assumed
route_policy.dated_access_notices: retain validity dates and refresh when implementing; not permanent closures

movement_policy.use: walking/driving and envelope review candidates only
